chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch 415: Han Li vs. a Teleporting Corpse Puppet & the Twin Saints' Secret
chapter_meta_description: Han Li fights a near-indestructible Corpse Puppet and escapes using a clever web-and-fire combo, only to uncover a shocking secret about the Star Palace's weakness.
og_title: A New Threat Emerges in the Starfall Sea!
og_description: Han Li uses every trick in his book to survive a relentless Corpse Puppet, while the Extreme Yin Ancestor reveals the Twin Saints' fatal flaw.
twitter_title: The Real Battle Is in the Shadows
twitter_description: Han Li escapes a teleporting Corpse Puppet, only to learn that the region's biggest power is crippled. The next arc starts here!

lore_anchors.definition: A high-tier undead creation refined from a human cadaver, often armored and imbued with regeneration; a classic demonic path tool in xianxia.
A condensed projectile of blood-type energy, capable of piercing most defenses; a signature attack of blood-path cultivators.
An ancient blood-type spirit beast that produces tough, flame-resistant webs; a high-value asset for binding and control.
A legendary technique harnessing primordial magnetic forces, granting domain-level power at the cost of mobility and freedom.
The dominant political and martial power in the Starfall Sea, ruled by the Twin Saints and based in the Heaven Star City.

surfaces: Twin Saints of Heaven and Star
lore_anchors.definition: The two highest-level cultivators of the Star Palace, currently crippled by the side effects of their Magnetic Divine Light technique.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A Corpse Puppet (炼尸) is a refined undead warrior, strengthened with metals and rituals to become a near-indestructible combat tool, often used by demonic cultivators.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Han Li just kill it?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It was immune to most of his attacks and healed from the ones that worked; killing it would have wasted too much time and resources, so he escaped.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Magnetic Divine Light?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A legendary technique that manipulates magnetic and elemental forces, granting immense power but shackling the user to a specific location to prevent cultivation regression.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Twin Saints' weakness important?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It means the Star Palace cannot project power effectively, leaving a power vacuum that the Extreme Yin Ancestor and other demonic factions can exploit.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Void Heaven Palace?
cultural_notes_faq.a: A legendary secret realm mentioned in passing; a major location for high-level cultivators to seek treasures and breakthroughs, now made less dangerous by the Twin Saints' absence.
